<script>
    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    /* Custom Date Picker – dark-themed, glassmorphic      */
    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    (function () {
        var MONTHS = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
            'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];
        var WEEKDAYS = ['Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa', 'Su'];

        // Shared overlay (click-outside-to-close)
        var overlay = document.createElement('div');
        overlay.className = 'cdp-overlay';
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            document.body.appendChild(overlay);
        });

        function pad(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }

        function daysInMonth(month, year) {
            return new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
        }

        function CustomDatePicker(inputEl) {
            if (typeof inputEl === 'string') inputEl = document.querySelector(inputEl);
            this.input = inputEl;
            this.isOpen = false;
            this.currentMonth = new Date().getMonth();
            this.currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
            this.selectedDate = new Date();

            // Set default value
            this.input.value = pad(this.selectedDate.getDate()) + '/' +
                pad(this.selectedDate.getMonth() + 1) + '/' + this.selectedDate.getFullYear();

            // Build calendar DOM
            this.calendarEl = document.createElement('div');
            this.calendarEl.className = 'cdp-calendar';
            document.body.appendChild(this.calendarEl);

            // Build structure
            this._buildHeader();
            this._buildWeekdays();
            this.daysContainer = document.createElement('div');
            this.daysContainer.className = 'cdp-days';
            this.calendarEl.appendChild(this.daysContainer);

            this._renderDays();

            // Bind events
            var self = this;
            this._onInputClick = function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (self.isOpen) { self.close(); } else { self.open(); }
            };
            this._onOverlayClick = function () { self.close(); };

            this.input.addEventListener('click', this._onInputClick);
            this.input.addEventListener('focus', function (e) { e.target.blur(); });
            this.input.setAttribute('readonly', 'readonly');
            this.input.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        }

        CustomDatePicker.prototype._buildHeader = function () {
            var header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'cdp-header';

            var prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
            prevBtn.type = 'button';
            prevBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>';
            var self = this;
            prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                self.currentMonth--;
                if (self.currentMonth < 0) { self.currentMonth = 11; self.currentYear--; }
                self._updateTitle();
                self._renderDays();
            });

            this.titleEl = document.createElement('span');
            this.titleEl.className = 'cdp-title';
            this._updateTitle();

            var nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
            nextBtn.type = 'button';
            nextBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>';
            nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                self.currentMonth++;
                if (self.currentMonth > 11) { self.currentMonth = 0; self.currentYear++; }
                self._updateTitle();
                self._renderDays();
            });

            header.appendChild(prevBtn);
            header.appendChild(this.titleEl);
            header.appendChild(nextBtn);
            this.calendarEl.appendChild(header);
        };

        CustomDatePicker.prototype._buildWeekdays = function () {
            var weekRow = document.createElement('div');
            weekRow.className = 'cdp-weekdays';
            for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
                var sp = document.createElement('span');
                sp.textContent = WEEKDAYS[i];
                weekRow.appendChild(sp);
            }
            this.calendarEl.appendChild(weekRow);
        };

        CustomDatePicker.prototype._updateTitle = function () {
            this.titleEl.textContent = MONTHS[this.currentMonth] + ' ' + this.currentYear;
        };

        CustomDatePicker.prototype._renderDays = function () {
            this.daysContainer.innerHTML = '';
            var totalDays = daysInMonth(this.currentMonth, this.currentYear);
            // getDay() → 0=Sun .. 6=Sat → convert so Mon=0
            var firstDay = new Date(this.currentYear, this.currentMonth, 1).getDay();
            var startOffset = (firstDay + 6) % 7; // Monday-first offset

            var today = new Date();
            var todayD = today.getDate(), todayM = today.getMonth(), todayY = today.getFullYear();
            var selD = this.selectedDate ? this.selectedDate.getDate() : -1;
            var selM = this.selectedDate ? this.selectedDate.getMonth() : -1;
            var selY = this.selectedDate ? this.selectedDate.getFullYear() : -1;

            // Previous month filler days
            var prevMonthDays = daysInMonth(
                this.currentMonth === 0 ? 11 : this.currentMonth - 1,
                this.currentMonth === 0 ? this.currentYear - 1 : this.currentYear
            );
            for (var p = startOffset - 1; p >= 0; p--) {
                var filler = document.createElement('button');
                filler.type = 'button';
                filler.className = 'cdp-day cdp-other-month';
                filler.textContent = prevMonthDays - p;
                this.daysContainer.appendChild(filler);
            }

            // Current month days
            var self = this;
            for (var d = 1; d <= totalDays; d++) {
                var dayBtn = document.createElement('button');
                dayBtn.type = 'button';
                dayBtn.className = 'cdp-day';
                dayBtn.textContent = d;

                if (d === todayD && this.currentMonth === todayM && this.currentYear === todayY) {
                    dayBtn.classList.add('cdp-today');
                }
                if (d === selD && this.currentMonth === selM && this.currentYear === selY) {
                    dayBtn.classList.add('cdp-selected');
                }

                (function (day) {
                    dayBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        self.selectedDate = new Date(self.currentYear, self.currentMonth, day);
                        self.input.value = pad(day) + '/' + pad(self.currentMonth + 1) + '/' + self.currentYear;
                        self._renderDays();
                        self.close();
                    });
                })(d);

                this.daysContainer.appendChild(dayBtn);
            }

            // Next month filler days
            var totalCells = startOffset + totalDays;
            var remaining = (7 - (totalCells % 7)) % 7;
            for (var n = 1; n <= remaining; n++) {
                var nfiller = document.createElement('button');
                nfiller.type = 'button';
                nfiller.className = 'cdp-day cdp-other-month';
                nfiller.textContent = n;
                this.daysContainer.appendChild(nfiller);
            }
        };

        CustomDatePicker.prototype.open = function () {
            // Close any other open pickers
            CustomDatePicker._closeAll();

            // Parse current value to sync calendar view
            if (this.input.value) {
                var parts = this.input.value.split('/');
                if (parts.length === 3) {
                    var dd = parseInt(parts[0], 10), mm = parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1, yy = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
                    if (!isNaN(dd) && !isNaN(mm) && !isNaN(yy)) {
                        this.selectedDate = new Date(yy, mm, dd);
                        this.currentMonth = mm;
                        this.currentYear = yy;
                    }
                }
            }

            this._updateTitle();
            this._renderDays();

            // Position calendar below input
            var rect = this.input.getBoundingClientRect();
            var scrollY = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
            var scrollX = window.pageXOffset || document.documentElement.scrollLeft;
            this.calendarEl.style.top = (rect.bottom + scrollY + 6) + 'px';
            this.calendarEl.style.left = (rect.left + scrollX) + 'px';

            // Show
            overlay.classList.add('open');
            overlay.addEventListener('click', this._onOverlayClick);

        min-height: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        /* animation removed */
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        -ms-overflow-style: none;
        padding-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .building::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
    }

    .building.building--fill .floor {
        flex: 1 0 auto;
    }

    .building.building--fill .floor-inner {
        flex: 1 0 auto;
    }

    .building.building--fill .floor-body {
        flex: 1 0 auto;
    }

    .building.building--fill .spots-grid {
        flex: 1;
        align-content: stretch;
        grid-auto-rows: minmax(110px, max-content);
    }

    .floor,
    .spot-card {
        overflow-anchor: none;
    }

    .floor {
        position: relative;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) !important;
        border-top: none !important;
        flex: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .floor:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }

    .slab {
        height: 0 !important;
        display: none !important;
        border: none !important;
    }

    .slab::after {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .slab::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 8px;
        background: var(--surface2);
        box-shadow: -3px 0 10px var(--shadow-soft);
    }

    .floor-inner {
        display: flex;
        flex: none;
        min-height: 0;
    }

    .floor-body {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
        padding: 10px 12px 12px 12px;
        gap: 10px;
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
    }

    .floor-label {
        width: 130px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 10px 8px;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
        flex-shrink: 0;
        transition: border-color 0.4s;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--surface2) 0%, transparent 100%);
    }

    .floor-num {
        font-family: var(--font-head);
        font-size: 26px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--blue);
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        line-height: 1;
        text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
    }

    .floor-total-wrap {
        text-align: center;
        background: var(--surface3);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 8px;
        width: 100%;
        transition: background-color 0.4s, border-color 0.4s, box-shadow 0.4s;
    }

    .floor-total-wrap:hover {
        background: var(--surface2);
        border-color: var(--border-hi);
    }

    .floor-total-label {
        font-size: 9px;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .1em;
        margin-bottom: 3px;
    }

    .floor-total-val {
        font-family: var(--font-data);
        font-size: 22px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--green);
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
    }

    .cap-bar-wrap {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 6px;
        padding: 0 4px;
    }

    .cap-bar-track {
        height: 7px;
        background: var(--surface3);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 99px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .cap-bar-fill {
        height: 100%;
        border-radius: 99px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--green));
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
        transition: width .6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    .cap-pct {
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-dim);
        text-align: center;
        margin-top: 3px;
    }

    .spots-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(175px, 1fr));
        gap: 8px;
        overflow: visible;
        padding-bottom: 4px;
        flex: none;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }

    .spot-card {
        position: relative;
        transform: translateZ(0);
        -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
        backface-visibility: hidden;
        -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
        background: var(--surface2);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 10px;
        transition: border-color .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, background-color .4s ease;
        cursor: pointer;
        overflow: hidden;
        pointer-events: auto;
        touch-action: auto;
    }

    .spot-card.empty {
        border-style: dashed;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .spot-card.empty {
        background: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.015) !important;
        border-color: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.2) !important;
    }

    .spot-card.empty:hover {
        border-color: var(--border-hi);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    }

    .spot-card::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 12px;
        right: 12px;
        height: 1px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), transparent);
        border-radius: 99px;
    }

    .spot-card:hover {
        border-color: var(--border-hi);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    }

    .spot-card.occupied {
        border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, .35);
        background: rgba(59, 130, 246, .06);
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 15px rgba(59, 130, 246, .03);
    }

    .spot-card.occupied::before {
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(59, 130, 246, .5), transparent);
    }

    .spot-card.occupied:hover {
        border-color: var(--blue);
        box-shadow: var(--glow-blue), inset 0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, .08);
    }

    .spot-card.charger-offline { }

    .spot-card.charger-offline::before {
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.5), transparent);
    }

    .spot-card.charger-offline:hover {
        border-color: var(--red);
        box-shadow: var(--glow-red), 0 0 15px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2);
    }

    .spot-card.charged {
        border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, .5);
        background: rgba(16, 185, 129, .05);
        box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
        animation: chargedPulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .spot-card.charged::before {
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(16, 185, 129, .6), transparent);
        animation: chargedShimmer 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .spot-card.charged:hover {
        border-color: var(--green);
        box-shadow: var(--glow-green), 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, .25);
    }

    @keyframes carFloat {

        0%,
        100% {
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        50% {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }
    }

    @keyframes energyPulse {

        0%,
        100% {
            transform: scale(0.9);
            opacity: 0.15;
        }

        50% {
            transform: scale(1.15);
            opacity: 0.35;
        }
    }

    @keyframes chargedPulse {

        0%,
        100% {
            box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
        }

        50% {
            box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35);
        }
    }

    @keyframes chargedShimmer {

        0%,
        100% {
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        50% {
            opacity: 1;
        }
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .spot-card.occupied {
        background: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.06);
        border-color: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.35);
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .spot-card.charged {
        background: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.06);
        border-color: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.4);
        box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.1);
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .spot-card.charger-offline { }

    [data-theme="light"] .spot-card.charged .power-num {
        color: var(--green) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .spot-card.charger-offline .power-num {
        color: var(--red) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .spot-card.charged .power-box {
        border-color: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.2) !important;
        background: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.05) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .spot-card.occupied .power-box {
        border-color: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.2) !important;
        background: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.05) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .modal {
        background: #ffffff !important;
        border-color: var(--border-hi) !important;
        box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .btn-modal-cancel {
        background: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.05) !important;
        color: var(--text-dim) !important;
        border-color: var(--border) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .btn-modal-cancel:hover {
        background: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.1) !important;
        color: var(--text) !important;
        border-color: var(--text-muted) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .btn-charger-start {
        background: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.08) !important;
        border-color: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.2) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .btn-charger-start:hover {
        background: var(--green) !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .btn-charger-stop {
        background: rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.08) !important;
        border-color: rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.2) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .btn-charger-stop:hover {
        background: var(--red) !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .btn-charger-switch {
        background: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.08) !important;
        border-color: rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.2) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .btn-charger-switch:hover {
        background: var(--blue) !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .charge-control-btn.start {
        border-color: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.35) !important;
        background: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.05) !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .charge-control-btn.stop {
        border-color: rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.35) !important;
        background: rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.05) !important;
    }

    @keyframes offlinePulse {

        0%,
        100% {
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.1);
        }

        50% {
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.3);
        }
    }

    .spot-head {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .spot-id {
        font-family: var(--font-data);
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-dim);
        letter-spacing: .08em;
    }

    .spot-status-dot.on {
        background: var(--green);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green);
        animation: statusBlink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .spot-status-dot.off {
        background: var(--text-muted);
        opacity: .35;
    }

    .spot-status-dot.offline {
        background: var(--red);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--red);
        animation: offlineBlink 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes offlineBlink {

        0%,
        100% {
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        50% {
            opacity: 1;
        }
    }

    @keyframes statusBlink {

        0%,
        100% {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        50% {
            opacity: .5;
        }
    }

    .spot-visual {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 6px;
        margin: 4px 0 6px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: visible;
    }

    .cable-wrap {
        z-index: 1 !important;
    }

    .car-wrap {
        flex: 1;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 4 !important;
    }

    .spot-card.charging .car-wrap::after,
    .spot-card.charged .car-wrap::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: 48px;
        height: 48px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 1;
        animation: energyPulse 2.5s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    .spot-card.occupied:not(.charging):not(.charged) .car-wrap::after {
        animation: none !important;
        display: none !important;
    }

    .spot-card.occupied .car-wrap::after {
        background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }

    .spot-card.charged .car-wrap::after {
        background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.22) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }

    .car-icon {
        font-size: 34px;
        transition: all .3s;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 4 !important;
    }

    .spot-card.occupied .car-icon {
        color: #60a5fa;
        filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.45));
    }

    .spot-card.occupied:hover .car-icon,
    .spot-card.charged:hover .car-icon {
        animation: carFloat 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .spot-card.empty .car-icon {
        color: var(--text-muted) !important;
        opacity: 0.25 !important;
        -webkit-text-stroke: 0 transparent !important;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .spot-card.empty .car-icon {
        color: var(--text-muted) !important;
        opacity: 0.25 !important;
        -webkit-text-stroke: 0 transparent !important;
    }

    .charger-icon {
        font-size: 24px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 4 !important;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        transition: all .3s;
    }

    .spot-card.occupied .charger-icon {
        color: #f59e0b;
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6));
    }

    .spot-card.charged .charger-icon {
        color: #10b981;
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.7));
    }

    .spot-card.empty .charger-icon {
        color: #64748b;
        opacity: .25;
    }

    .spot-card.empty .cable-path {
        display: none;
    }

    .car-name {
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text);
        margin: -2px 0 6px;
        min-height: 14px;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .edit-btn {
        position: absolute;
        top: 6px;
        right: 6px;
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.4);
        backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 6px;
        color: var(--text-dim);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        font-size: 10px;
        cursor: pointer;
        opacity: 0.8;
        transition: all .2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        z-index: 100;
        pointer-events: auto;
        touch-action: auto;
    }

    .spot-card:hover .edit-btn {
        opacity: 1;
    }

    .edit-btn:hover {
        background: var(--blue);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: var(--blue);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5);
    }

    .charge-control-btn {
        position: absolute;
        top: 6px;
        right: 32px;
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.4);
        backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 6px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        font-size: 10px;
        cursor: pointer;
        z-index: 101;
        transition: all .2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    .charge-control-btn.start {
        color: var(--green);
        border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
        background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05);
    }

    .charge-control-btn.start:hover {
        background: var(--green);
        color: #111;
        border-color: var(--green);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5);
    }

    .charge-control-btn.start:hover i,
    .charge-control-btn.stop:hover i {
        color: inherit;
    }

    .charge-control-btn.stop {
        color: var(--red);
        border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.3);
        background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.05);
    }

    .charge-control-btn.stop:hover {
        background: var(--red);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: var(--red);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.5);
    }

    .power-box {
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: 6px 10px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 4px;
        margin-top: auto;
        transition: background-color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;
    }

    .spot-card.occupied .power-box {
        border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
        background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05);
    }

    .spot-card.charged .power-box {
        border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
        background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05);
    }

    .power-num {
        font-family: var(--font-data);
        font-size: 17px;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1;
    }

    .spot-card.occupied .power-num {
        color: var(--blue);
        text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
    }

    .spot-card.empty .power-num {
        color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .power-unit-label {
        font-family: var(--font-data);
        font-size: 10px;
        color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .power-mini-bar {
        margin-top: 5px;
        height: 2px;
        background: var(--border);
        border-radius: 99px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .power-mini-fill {
        height: 100%;
        border-radius: 99px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--green));
        box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--green);
        transition: width .8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    .modal-overlay {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        background: rgba(7, 10, 19, 0.6);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        z-index: 100000;
        display: none;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity .3s ease;
        padding: 16px;
        pointer-events: none;
        touch-action: auto;
    }

    .modal-overlay.open {
        display: flex;
        opacity: 1;
        pointer-events: auto;
        touch-action: auto !important;
    }

    .modal-overlay.open * {
        touch-action: auto !important;
        pointer-events: auto !important;
    }

    .modal {
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
        backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        border-radius: 16px;
        padding: 22px;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 320px; /* base default */
        box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
        transform: scale(0.95) translateY(10px);
        transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        pointer-events: auto;
        touch-action: auto;
        user-select: text;
        -webkit-user-select: text;
    }

    .modal-overlay.open .modal {
        transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
    }

            padding: 18px !important;
            margin-top: 10px !important;

            font-size: 24px !important;
            padding: 10px !important;
            width: 130px !important;
        }

    /* Specific grow/shrink transitions and styles for adminModal configuration */
    #adminModal {
        display: none;
        opacity: 0;

<script>
    window.chargerMatches = function (allowedStr, id) {
        if (!allowedStr || !id) return false;
        var list = allowedStr.split(',').map(function (s) { return s.trim(); });
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            var a = list[i];
            if (a === id) return true;
            if (id.split('_')[0] === a.split('_')[0]) return true;
        }
        return false;
    };

    window.sendMultiChoice = function (cardId, chargerId) {
        document.getElementById('multiChargerModal').style.display = 'none';
        if (window.ngScope) {
            window.ngScope.send({ topic: 'rfid_multi_choice', payload: { card_id: cardId, is_choice: true, charger_choice: chargerId } });
        }
    };

    window.sendMultiSwitchChoice = function (cardId, chargerId, switchFromId) {
        document.getElementById('multiChargerModal').style.display = 'none';
        if (window.ngScope) {
            window.ngScope.send({
                topic: 'rfid_multi_choice',
                payload: {
                    card_id: cardId,
                    is_choice: true,
                    charger_choice: chargerId,
                    switch_from: switchFromId
                }
            });
        }
    };

    window.promptConfirm = function (titleHtml, bodyText, btnColor, btnTextColor, onSuccess) {
        var modal = document.getElementById('uiChargeModal');
        var pinSec = document.getElementById('uiChargePinSec');
        var userSec = document.getElementById('uiChargeUserSec');
        var confirmSec = document.getElementById('uiChargeConfirmSec');
        var confirmPrompt = document.getElementById('uiChargeConfirmPrompt');
        var submitBtn = document.getElementById('uiChargeSubmitBtn');
        var title = document.getElementById('uiChargeTitle');

        title.innerHTML = titleHtml;
        submitBtn.style.background = btnColor;
        submitBtn.style.color = btnTextColor;

        userSec.style.display = 'none';
        pinSec.style.display = 'none';
        if (confirmSec) {
            confirmSec.style.display = 'block';
            confirmPrompt.innerHTML = bodyText;
        }

        modal.style.display = 'flex';

        submitBtn.onclick = function () {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            onSuccess();
        };
    };

    window.confirmSwitchCharging = function (cardId, chargerId, switchFromId) {
        window.promptConfirm(
            '<i class="fas fa-random" style="color:var(--blue);"></i> Switch Charging',
            'Do you want to stop charging on <strong>' + switchFromId + '</strong> and start on <strong>' + chargerId + '</strong>?',
            'var(--blue)',
            '#fff',
            function () {
                window.sendMultiSwitchChoice(cardId, chargerId, switchFromId);
            }
        );
    };

    window.changeAmp = function (zoneId, spot, value) {
        var val = parseInt(value, 10);
        if (isNaN(val) || val < 6) val = 6;
        if (val > 32) val = 32;
        var s = parkingData.find(function (p) { return normalizeZoneId(p.zoneId) === normalizeZoneId(zoneId) && Number(p.spot) === Number(spot); });
        if (s) {
            s.amp = val;
            s.targetAmp = val;
            s.desiredAmp = val;
            s.userSetAmp = val;
            var card = document.querySelector('.spot-card[data-zone="' + s.zoneId + '"][data-spot="' + s.spot + '"]');
            if (card) {
                var ampEl = card.querySelector('#amp-val-' + s.zoneId + '-' + s.spot) || card.querySelector('.spot-amp-val');
                if (ampEl) ampEl.textContent = val + ' A';
            }
            renderBuilding();
        }
        if (window.ngScope) {
            window.ngScope.send({
                topic: 'set_charger_amp',
                payload: {
                    zoneId: zoneId,
                    spot: spot,
                    amp: val
                }
            });

        }
    };

    // --- Direct UI Start/Stop Charging Control & PIN Authorization ---
    window.closeUIChargeModal = function () {
        document.getElementById('uiChargeModal').style.display = 'none';
    };

    window.promptPIN = function (userName, correctPin, onSuccess) {
        var modal = document.getElementById('uiChargeModal');
        var pinSec = document.getElementById('uiChargePinSec');
        var userSec = document.getElementById('uiChargeUserSec');
        var confirmSec = document.getElementById('uiChargeConfirmSec');
        var pinPrompt = document.getElementById('uiChargePinPrompt');
        var pinInput = document.getElementById('uiChargePinInput');
        var pinErr = document.getElementById('uiChargePinError');
        var submitBtn = document.getElementById('uiChargeSubmitBtn');
        var title = document.getElementById('uiChargeTitle');

        title.textContent = 'Enter PIN';
        submitBtn.style.background = 'var(--amber)';
        submitBtn.style.color = '#111';

        userSec.style.display = 'none';
        pinSec.style.display = 'block';
        if (confirmSec) confirmSec.style.display = 'none';
        pinPrompt.textContent = 'Enter PIN for driver: ' + userName;
        pinInput.value = '';
        pinErr.style.display = 'none';
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        setTimeout(function () {
            pinInput.focus();
            try {
                var content = document.getElementById('uiChargeContent');
                if (content && typeof content.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
                    content.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }, 150);

        submitBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (pinInput.value.trim() === String(correctPin)) {
                modal.style.display = 'none';
                onSuccess();
            } else {
                pinErr.style.display = 'block';
                pinInput.value = '';
                pinInput.focus();
            }
        };

        pinInput.onkeydown = function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                submitBtn.click();
            }
        };
    };

    window.showUIUserSelector = function (matchingUsers, chargerId, zoneId, spot) {
        var modal = document.getElementById('uiChargeModal');
        var pinSec = document.getElementById('uiChargePinSec');
        var userSec = document.getElementById('uiChargeUserSec');
        var confirmSec = document.getElementById('uiChargeConfirmSec');
        var select = document.getElementById('uiChargeUserSelect');
        var submitBtn = document.getElementById('uiChargeSubmitBtn');
        var title = document.getElementById('uiChargeTitle');

        var isSmappee = (chargerId && chargerId.toLowerCase().indexOf('smappee') !== -1);

        title.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-user-circle" style="color:var(--blue);"></i> Select Driver';
        submitBtn.style.background = 'var(--blue)';
        submitBtn.style.color = '#fff';

        select.innerHTML = matchingUsers.map(function (u) {
            return '<option value="' + u.cardId + '">' + u.name + ((u.pin && !isSmappee) ? ' (PIN Required)' : ' (No PIN)') + '</option>';
        }).join('');

        userSec.style.display = 'block';
        pinSec.style.display = 'none';
        if (confirmSec) confirmSec.style.display = 'none';
        modal.style.display = 'flex';

        submitBtn.onclick = function () {
            var chosenCardId = select.value;
            var userObj = matchingUsers.find(function (u) { return u.cardId === chosenCardId; });
            if (userObj) {
                if (userObj.pin && !isSmappee) {
                    promptPIN(userObj.name, userObj.pin, function () {
                        applyOptimisticChargingState(zoneId, spot, true, userObj, chargerId);
                        if (window.ngScope) {
                            window.ngScope.send({
                                topic: 'rfid_multi_choice',
                                payload: { card_id: userObj.cardId, is_choice: true, charger_choice: chargerId, command: 'start' }
                            });
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                    applyOptimisticChargingState(zoneId, spot, true, userObj, chargerId);
                    if (window.ngScope) {
                        window.ngScope.send({
                            topic: 'rfid_multi_choice',
                            payload: { card_id: userObj.cardId, is_choice: true, charger_choice: chargerId, command: 'start' }
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        };
    };

    window.applyOptimisticChargingState = function (zoneId, spot, isStart, userObj, chargerId) {
        if ((!zoneId || spot === undefined || spot === null) && chargerId && window.currentSmartConfig && window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS && window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS[chargerId]) {
            zoneId = window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS[chargerId].zone;
            spot = window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS[chargerId].spot;
        }
        var pData = (window.parkingData && window.parkingData.length) ? window.parkingData : (typeof parkingData !== 'undefined' ? parkingData : []);
        var s = pData.find(function (p) {
            return normalizeZoneId(p.zoneId) === normalizeZoneId(zoneId) && Number(p.spot) === Number(spot);
        });
        if (s) {
            if (isStart) {
                s.isCharging = true;
                s.occupied = true;
                if (userObj) {
                    s.name = userObj.name || s.name;
                    s.activeUser = userObj.name;
                    s.activeCard = userObj.cardId;
                }
            } else {
                s.isCharging = false;
                s.power = 0;
            }
            if (typeof renderBuilding === 'function') renderBuilding();
            if (typeof updateKPIs === 'function') updateKPIs();
            if (typeof updateFloorTotals === 'function') updateFloorTotals();
        }
    };

    window.toggleChargingFromUI = function (zoneId, spot, action) {
        var chargerId = null;
        if (window.currentSmartConfig && window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS) {
            var nz = normalizeZoneId(zoneId);
            for (var cid in window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS) {
                var ch = window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS[cid];
                if (normalizeZoneId(ch.zone) === nz && Number(ch.spot) === Number(spot)) {
                    chargerId = cid;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!chargerId) {
            alert("No charger configured for this spot!");
            return;
        }

        var isSmappee = chargerId && chargerId.toLowerCase().indexOf('smappee') !== -1;

        if (isSmappee) {
            var smappeeAction = action === 'stop' ? 'stop' : 'start';
            window.promptConfirm(
                smappeeAction === 'stop'
                    ? '<i class="fas fa-stop-circle" style="color:var(--red);"></i> Stop Charging'
                    : '<i class="fas fa-play-circle" style="color:var(--green);"></i> Start Charging',
                smappeeAction === 'stop'
                    ? 'Do you want to stop charging on Smappee charger?'
                    : 'Do you want to start charging on Smappee charger?',
                smappeeAction === 'stop' ? 'var(--red)' : 'var(--green)',
                smappeeAction === 'stop' ? '#fff' : '#111',
                function () {
                    sendSmappeeDirectControl(chargerId, zoneId, spot, smappeeAction);
                }
            );
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'stop') {
            // STOP: Find the active card/user for this spot
            var cardId = null;
            var s = parkingData.find(function (p) { return p.zoneId === zoneId && Number(p.spot) === Number(spot); });
            if (s) {
                if (s.activeCard) cardId = s.activeCard;
                if (!cardId && s.activeUser) {
                    for (var cid in window.currentSmartConfig.USERS) {
                        var u = window.currentSmartConfig.USERS[cid];
                        if (u.name === s.activeUser && window.chargerMatches(u.charger, chargerId)) {
                            cardId = cid;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!cardId && s.occupied && s.name) {
                    for (var cid in window.currentSmartConfig.USERS) {
                        var u = window.currentSmartConfig.USERS[cid];
                        if (u.name === s.name && window.chargerMatches(u.charger, chargerId)) {
                            cardId = cid;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!cardId) {
                for (var cid in window.currentSmartConfig.USERS) {
                    var u = window.currentSmartConfig.USERS[cid];
                    if (window.chargerMatches(u.charger, chargerId)) {
                        cardId = cid;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!cardId) {
                cardId = Object.keys(window.currentSmartConfig.USERS)[0];
            }
            if (!cardId) {
                applyOptimisticChargingState(zoneId, spot, false, null, chargerId);
                if (window.ngScope) {
                    window.ngScope.send({
                        topic: 'rfid_multi_choice',
                        payload: { card_id: 'MASTER_CARD', is_choice: true, charger_choice: chargerId, command: 'stop' }
                    });
                }
                return;
            }

            var userObj = window.currentSmartConfig.USERS[cardId];
            if (userObj && userObj.pin) {
                promptPIN(userObj.name, userObj.pin, function () {
                    applyOptimisticChargingState(zoneId, spot, false, null, chargerId);
                    if (window.ngScope) {
                        window.ngScope.send({
                            topic: 'rfid_multi_choice',
                            payload: { card_id: cardId, is_choice: true, charger_choice: chargerId, command: 'stop' }
                        });
                    }
                });
            } else {
                applyOptimisticChargingState(zoneId, spot, false, null, chargerId);
                if (window.ngScope) {
                    window.ngScope.send({
                        topic: 'rfid_multi_choice',
                        payload: { card_id: cardId, is_choice: true, charger_choice: chargerId, command: 'stop' }
                    });
                }
            }
        } else {
            // START: Find users assigned to this charger
            var matchingUsers = [];
            for (var cid in window.currentSmartConfig.USERS) {
                var u = window.currentSmartConfig.USERS[cid];
                if (window.chargerMatches(u.charger, chargerId)) {
                    matchingUsers.push({ cardId: cid, name: u.name, pin: u.pin || '' });
                }
            }
            if (matchingUsers.length === 0) {
                alert("No registered RFID users assigned to charger " + chargerId + "!");
                return;
            }
            if (matchingUsers.length > 1) {
                showUIUserSelector(matchingUsers, chargerId, zoneId, spot);
            } else {
                var userObj = matchingUsers[0];
                if (userObj.pin) {
                    promptPIN(userObj.name, userObj.pin, function () {
                        applyOptimisticChargingState(zoneId, spot, true, userObj, chargerId);
                        if (window.ngScope) {
                            window.ngScope.send({
                                topic: 'rfid_multi_choice',
                                payload: { card_id: userObj.cardId, is_choice: true, charger_choice: chargerId, command: 'start' }
                            });
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    applyOptimisticChargingState(zoneId, spot, true, userObj, chargerId);
                    if (window.ngScope) {
                        window.ngScope.send({
                            topic: 'rfid_multi_choice',
                            payload: { card_id: userObj.cardId, is_choice: true, charger_choice: chargerId, command: 'start' }
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    };

    function loadReportLogoDataUri() {
        if (window._reportLogoDataUri) {
            return Promise.resolve(window._reportLogoDataUri);
        }
        return fetch(REPORT_LOGO_URL, { cache: 'force-cache' })
            .then(function (res) {
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Logo fetch failed');
                return res.blob();
            })
            .then(function (blob) {
                return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                    var reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function () {
                        window._reportLogoDataUri = reader.result;
                        resolve(window._reportLogoDataUri);
                    };
                    reader.onerror = reject;
                    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
                });
            })
            .catch(function () {
                window._reportLogoDataUri = 'data:image/png;base64,' + REPORT_LOGO_B64_FALLBACK;
                return window._reportLogoDataUri;
            });
    }

    window.requestHistoryAndGenerate = function () {
        function parseInputDate(str) {
            if (!str) return new Date();
            if (str.indexOf('/') !== -1) {
                var parts = str.split('/');
                return new Date(parseInt(parts[2], 10), parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(parts[0], 10));
            } else {
                var parts = str.split('-');
                return new Date(parseInt(parts[0], 10), parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(parts[2], 10));
            }
        }

        var rangeType = document.querySelector('input[name="reportRangeType"]:checked').value;
        if (rangeType === 'day') {
            var targetDayVal = document.getElementById('reportDaySelect').value;
            if (!targetDayVal) {
                window.showCustomAlert('Please select a date!');
                return;
            }
        } else if (rangeType === 'range') {
            var startVal = document.getElementById('reportRangeStart').value;
            var endVal = document.getElementById('reportRangeEnd').value;
            if (!startVal || !endVal) {
                window.showCustomAlert('Please select start and end dates!');
                return;
            }
            var dStart = parseInputDate(startVal);
            var dEnd = parseInputDate(endVal);
            var startDate = new Date(dStart.getFullYear(), dStart.getMonth(), dStart.getDate(), 0, 0, 0);
            var endDate = new Date(dEnd.getFullYear(), dEnd.getMonth(), dEnd.getDate(), 23, 59, 59);
            if (startDate > endDate) {
                window.showCustomAlert('Start date cannot be after end date!');
                return;
            }
        }

        if (window.lastLoadedHistory) {
            var filtered = window.getFilteredSessions(window.lastLoadedHistory);
            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                window.showCustomAlert('No charging sessions found for the selected period!');
                return;
            }
        }

        window.showPdfGeneratingOverlay();
        window.generatingPDF = true;
        if (window.ngScope) {
            window.ngScope.send({ topic: 'get_charging_history' });
        } else {
            window.hidePdfGeneratingOverlay();
            window.showCustomAlert('Connection error. Try again.');
        }
    };

    window.generatePDFReport = function (history) {
        history = Array.isArray(history) ? history.slice() : [];

        function getPosition(x) {
            if (!x.zoneId || !x.spot) return x.chargerId || '—';
            var spotNum = Number(x.spot);
            var pos = '';
            if (isNaN(spotNum) || spotNum <= 0) {
                pos = x.zoneId + '-' + x.spot;
            } else {
                pos = x.zoneId + '-' + String.fromCharCode(64 + spotNum);
            }
            if (x.chargerId) {
                pos += ' (' + x.chargerId + ')';
            }
            return pos;
        }

        function cleanGreekUpper(str) {
            if (!str) return '';
            var mapping = {
                'ά': 'α', 'έ': 'ε', 'ή': 'η', 'ί': 'ι', 'ό': 'ο', 'ύ': 'υ', 'ώ': 'ω',
                'ϊ': 'ι', 'ϋ': 'υ', 'ΐ': 'ι', 'ΰ': 'υ',
                'Ά': 'Α', 'Έ': 'Ε', 'Ή': 'Η', 'Ί': 'Ι', 'Ό': 'Ο', 'Ύ': 'Υ', 'Ώ': 'Ω',
                'Ϊ': 'Ι', 'Ϋ': 'Υ'
            };
            var clean = '';
            for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
                var ch = str[i];
                clean += mapping[ch] || ch;
            }
            return clean.toUpperCase();
        }

        // Inject active (uncompleted) sessions into the report history
        if (Array.isArray(parkingData)) {
            parkingData.forEach(function (s) {
                var isCharging = !!s.isCharging || ((Number(s.power) || 0) >= 0.05);
                var durSec = s.chargingDurationSec || 0;
                var durMin = Math.floor(durSec / 60);
                if (durMin === 0 && (isCharging || s.isCharged || (s.sessionEnergy && s.sessionEnergy > 0.01))) {
                    var startRef = s.chargingStartedAt || (isCharging ? s.connectedAt : 0);
                    if (startRef) {
                        durMin = Math.max(1, Math.floor(((s.isCharged && s.fullyChargedAt ? s.fullyChargedAt : Date.now()) - startRef) / 60000));
                    }
                }

                // Only include in reports if the car is/was actually charging, not just plugged in idle
                if (s.occupied && (durMin > 0 || isCharging || s.isCharged || (s.sessionEnergy && s.sessionEnergy > 0.01))) {
                    var activeCid = s.zoneId + '_' + s.spot;
                    if (window.currentSmartConfig && window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS) {
                        for (var cid in window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS) {
                            var ch = window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS[cid];
                            if (normalizeZoneId(ch.zone) === normalizeZoneId(s.zoneId) && Number(ch.spot) === Number(s.spot)) {
                                activeCid = cid;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    var activeRec = {
                        chargerId: activeCid,
                        zoneId: s.zoneId,
                        spot: s.spot,
                        name: s.name || 'Unknown',
                        user: s.activeUser || s.name || 'Unknown',
                        connectedAt: s.connectedAt || Date.now(),
                        disconnectedAt: s.isCharged && s.fullyChargedAt ? s.fullyChargedAt : Date.now(),
                        durationMinutes: durMin,
                        energyKWh: Number(s.sessionEnergy || 0),
                        timestamp: new Date(s.connectedAt || Date.now()).toISOString(),
                        isActive: true

                                img.onload = function () { resolve(); };

                    return Promise.all(promises);

                }).then(function () {
                    var opt = {

                    };

                    var worker = html2pdf().set(opt).from(printDiv);
                    worker.toPdf()
                        .get('pdf')
                        .then(function (pdf) {
                            try {
                                var totalPages = pdf.internal.getNumberOfPages();
                                if (totalPages > 1) {
                                    pdf.setFontSize(9);
                                    pdf.setTextColor(100, 116, 139);
                                    for (var i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
                                        pdf.setPage(i);
                                        var pageW = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
                                        var pageH = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
                                        var label = 'Page ' + i + ' of ' + totalPages;
                                        pdf.text(label, pageW - 14, pageH - 12, { align: 'right' });
                                    }
                                }
                            } catch (e) {
                                console.warn('Failed to add page numbers:', e);
                            }
                        })
                        .then(function () {
                            return worker.save();
                        })
                        .then(function () {
                            if (pdfContainer.parentNode) {
                                pdfContainer.parentNode.removeChild(pdfContainer);
                            }
                            window.hidePdfGeneratingOverlay();
                            closeReportsModal();
                        })
                        .catch(function (err) {
                            if (pdfContainer.parentNode) {
                                pdfContainer.parentNode.removeChild(pdfContainer);
                            }
                            window.hidePdfGeneratingOverlay();
                            alert('PDF Generation failed: ' + err.message);
                        });
                });
            });

    function rebuildParkingData() {
        var snapshot = {};
        parkingData.forEach(function (s) {
            var key = normalizeZoneId(s.zoneId) + '-' + Number(s.spot);
            snapshot[key] = {
                name: s.name,
                color: s.color,
                occupied: s.occupied,
                isOffline: s.isOffline,
                power: s.power,
                amp: s.amp,
                isCharged: s.isCharged,
                connectedAt: s.connectedAt,
                fullyChargedAt: s.fullyChargedAt,
                activeCard: s.activeCard,
                activeUser: s.activeUser
            };
        });
        initData();
        parkingData.forEach(function (s) {
            var spotChargerId = getChargerIdForSpot(s.zoneId, s.spot);
            if (!spotChargerId) {
                s.occupied = false;
                s.power = 0;
                s.isCharging = false;
                s.isOffline = false;
                return;
            }
            var key = normalizeZoneId(s.zoneId) + '-' + Number(s.spot);
            var prev = snapshot[key];
            if (!prev) {
                for (var oldKey in snapshot) {
                    var sn = snapshot[oldKey];
                    if (sn && (sn.occupied || sn.power > 0)) {
                        var parts = oldKey.split('-');
                        var oldChargerId = getChargerIdForSpot(parts[0], parts[1]);
                        if (!oldChargerId) {
                            prev = sn;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!prev) return;
            if (prev.name) s.name = prev.name;
            if (prev.color) s.color = prev.color;
            if (prev.amp !== undefined && prev.amp !== null) s.amp = prev.amp;
            s.occupied = !!prev.occupied;
            s.isOffline = false;
            s.power = prev.power || 0;
            s.isCharged = !!prev.isCharged;
            if (prev.connectedAt) s.connectedAt = prev.connectedAt;
            if (prev.fullyChargedAt) s.fullyChargedAt = prev.fullyChargedAt;
            if (prev.activeCard) s.activeCard = prev.activeCard;
            if (prev.activeUser) s.activeUser = prev.activeUser;
        });
        clearTimeout(window._rebuildTimer);
        window._rebuildTimer = setTimeout(function () {
            renderBuilding();
            updateKPIs();
            updateFloorTotals();
        }, 100);
    }

    window.dumpCableDebug = function (zoneId, spot) {
        var rows = [];
        var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.spot-card.occupied');
        var filterZone = zoneId !== undefined && zoneId !== null ? normalizeZoneId(zoneId) : null;
        var filterSpot = spot !== undefined && spot !== null ? Number(spot) : null;

        cards.forEach(function (card) {
            var cardZone = card.getAttribute('data-zone');
            var cardSpot = Number(card.getAttribute('data-spot'));
            if (filterZone && normalizeZoneId(cardZone) !== filterZone) return;
            if (filterSpot !== null && cardSpot !== filterSpot) return;

            var visual = card.querySelector('.spot-visual');
            var cable = card.querySelector('.cable-wrap');
            var path = cable ? cable.querySelector('.cable-path') : null;
            var dot = cable ? cable.querySelector('circle') : null;
            var charger = card.querySelector('.charger-icon');
            var row = {
                zone: cardZone,
                spot: cardSpot,
                hasCable: !!cable,
                hasPath: !!path,
                hasDot: !!dot
            };

            if (visual) {
                var vr = visual.getBoundingClientRect();
                row.visualRect = { left: Math.round(vr.left), right: Math.round(vr.right), top: Math.round(vr.top), bottom: Math.round(vr.bottom), width: Math.round(vr.width), height: Math.round(vr.height) };
            }
            if (cable) {
                var cr = cable.getBoundingClientRect();
                row.cableRect = { left: Math.round(cr.left), right: Math.round(cr.right), top: Math.round(cr.top), bottom: Math.round(cr.bottom), width: Math.round(cr.width), height: Math.round(cr.height) };
                row.cableViewBox = cable.getAttribute('viewBox') || '';
            }
            if (charger) {
                var chr = charger.getBoundingClientRect();
                row.chargerRect = { left: Math.round(chr.left), right: Math.round(chr.right), top: Math.round(chr.top), bottom: Math.round(chr.bottom), width: Math.round(chr.width), height: Math.round(chr.height) };
            }
            if (path && typeof path.getTotalLength === 'function') {
                var total = path.getTotalLength();
                row.pathLength = Math.round(total * 100) / 100;
                var start = path.getPointAtLength(0);
                var end = path.getPointAtLength(total);
                var ctm = path.getScreenCTM();
                if (ctm) {
                    row.pathStartScreen = { x: Math.round(ctm.a * start.x + ctm.c * start.y + ctm.e), y: Math.round(ctm.b * start.x + ctm.d * start.y + ctm.f) };
                    row.pathEndScreen = { x: Math.round(ctm.a * end.x + ctm.c * end.y + ctm.e), y: Math.round(ctm.b * end.x + ctm.d * end.y + ctm.f) };
                } else {
                    row.pathStartLocal = { x: Math.round(start.x), y: Math.round(start.y) };
                    row.pathEndLocal = { x: Math.round(end.x), y: Math.round(end.y) };
                }
            }
            if (dot) {
                var dr = dot.getBoundingClientRect();
                row.dotRect = { left: Math.round(dr.left), right: Math.round(dr.right), top: Math.round(dr.top), bottom: Math.round(dr.bottom), width: Math.round(dr.width), height: Math.round(dr.height) };
            }
            rows.push(row);
        });

        console.table(rows.map(function (r) {
            return {
                zone: r.zone,
                spot: r.spot,
                cableW: r.cableRect ? r.cableRect.width : null,
                pathLen: r.pathLength || null,
                dot: r.hasDot,
                pathStartX: r.pathStartScreen ? r.pathStartScreen.x : null,
                pathEndX: r.pathEndScreen ? r.pathEndScreen.x : null,
                chargerLeft: r.chargerRect ? r.chargerRect.left : null,
                chargerRight: r.chargerRect ? r.chargerRect.right : null
            };
        }));
        console.log('[cable-debug:full]', rows);
        return rows;
    };

    function getChargerIdForSpot(zoneId, spot) {
        if (!window.currentSmartConfig || !window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS) return null;
        var nz = normalizeZoneId(zoneId);
        for (var cid in window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS) {
            var ch = window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS[cid];
            if (normalizeZoneId(ch.zone) === nz && Number(ch.spot) === Number(spot)) return cid;
        }
        return null;

                var existingCards = existingFloors[zi].querySelectorAll('.spot-card');

        // ONLY FOR PC - NOT FOR MOBILE
        if (window.innerWidth <= 600) return;

        var buildingEl = document.getElementById('building');
        if (!window._buildingScrollAccumulator) window._buildingScrollAccumulator = 0;

        // Disable mouse wheel on page — redirect to #building scroll container
        window.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
            var inAdmin = e.target.closest('#adminModal');
            var inEditModal = e.target.closest('#editModal');
            var inLimitModal = e.target.closest('#limitModal');

            if (inAdmin) {
                var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('#adminModal .admin-tab-content');
                var activeTab = null;
                for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
                    if (tabs[i].style.display !== 'none') {
                        activeTab = tabs[i];
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (activeTab && e.deltaY !== 0) {
                    if (!window._adminScrollAccumulator) window._adminScrollAccumulator = 0;
                    window._adminScrollAccumulator += e.deltaY;
                    var toScroll = Math.trunc(window._adminScrollAccumulator);
                    if (toScroll !== 0) {
                        activeTab.scrollTop += toScroll;
                        window._adminScrollAccumulator -= toScroll;
                    }
                    e.preventDefault();
                }
                return;
            }

            if (inEditModal || inLimitModal || e.target.closest('#rfidModal')) {
                return;
            }

            // Scroll the building panel with mouse wheel only when it overflows
            if (buildingEl && e.deltaY !== 0) {
                var canScroll = buildingEl.scrollHeight > buildingEl.clientHeight + 1;
                if (canScroll) {
                    window._buildingScrollAccumulator += e.deltaY;
                    var bScroll = Math.trunc(window._buildingScrollAccumulator);
                    if (bScroll !== 0) {
                        buildingEl.scrollTop += bScroll;
                        window._buildingScrollAccumulator -= bScroll;
                    }
                    e.preventDefault();
                }
                return;
            }
            if (!e.target.closest('#rfidModal') && !inAdmin && !inEditModal && !inLimitModal) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        }, { passive: false });

        // Disable keyboard scrolling
        window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            var keys = [32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 38, 40]; // Space, PgUp, PgDn, End, Home, Up, Down
            if (keys.indexOf(e.keyCode) > -1) {
                // Exception if user is typing in an input (e.g. Edit Vehicle) or inside modal
                if (document.activeElement && (document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT' || document.activeElement.tagName === 'TEXTAREA')) return;

                userGroup.style.display = 'none';
                userInput.value = '';
            }
        }

        // Check if this spot has an active charger
        var hasCharger = false;
        var currentAmp = spot.amp || 16;
        var chargerType = '';
        var confCharger = {};
        if (window.currentSmartConfig && window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS) {
            for (var cid in window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS) {
                var ch = window.currentSmartConfig.CHARGERS[cid];
                if (normalizeZoneId(ch.zone) === normalizeZoneId(spot.zoneId) && Number(ch.spot) === Number(spot.spot)) {
                    hasCharger = true;
                    chargerType = ch.type || (cid.toLowerCase().indexOf('victron') !== -1 ? 'victron' : (cid.toLowerCase().indexOf('easee') !== -1 ? 'easee' : (cid.toLowerCase().indexOf('smappee') !== -1 ? 'smappee' : 'goe')));

                ampGroup.style.display = 'block';
                var slider = document.getElementById('editAmpSlider');
                if (slider) {
                    var defaultMinAmp = (chargerType === 'victron') ? 6 : 6;
                    var defaultMaxAmp = (chargerType === 'victron') ? 20 : 32;

                    var minAmp = (confCharger.minAmp !== undefined && confCharger.minAmp !== null) ? Number(confCharger.minAmp) : defaultMinAmp;
                    var maxAmp = (confCharger.maxAmp !== undefined && confCharger.maxAmp !== null) ? Number(confCharger.maxAmp)
                        : ((confCharger.amp !== undefined && confCharger.amp !== null) ? Number(confCharger.amp) : defaultMaxAmp);

                    slider.min = minAmp;
                    slider.max = maxAmp;

                    var safeAmp = currentAmp;
                    if (safeAmp < minAmp) safeAmp = minAmp;
                    if (safeAmp > maxAmp) safeAmp = maxAmp;

                    slider.value = safeAmp;

                startX = touch.clientX;
                startY = touch.clientY;
                isSwiping = true;
                currentDx = 0;
                currentDy = 0;
                if (autoCloseTimer) { clearTimeout(autoCloseTimer); autoCloseTimer = null; }
                notifCard.style.transition = 'none';
            }

            function onTouchMove(e) {
                if (!isSwiping || !e.touches) return;
                var touch = e.touches[0];
                currentDx = touch.clientX - startX;
                currentDy = touch.clientY - startY;

                if (currentDy > 30) currentDy = 30 + (currentDy - 30) * 0.2;

                var dist = Math.hypot(currentDx, currentDy);
                var opacity = Math.max(0.2, 1 - (dist / 220));

                notifCard.style.transform = 'translate(' + currentDx + 'px, ' + currentDy + 'px) scale(' + (1 - Math.min(0.1, dist / 800)) + ')';
                notifCard.style.opacity = opacity;
                if (e.cancelable && (Math.abs(currentDx) > 8 || currentDy < -8)) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                }
            }

            function onTouchEnd(e) {
                if (!isSwiping) return;
                isSwiping = false;

                var isSwipeRight = currentDx > 50;
                var isSwipeLeft = currentDx < -50;
                var isSwipeUp = currentDy < -35;

                if (isSwipeRight) {
                    closeNotifModal('right');
                } else if (isSwipeLeft) {
                    closeNotifModal('left');
                } else if (isSwipeUp) {
                    closeNotifModal('up');
                } else {
                    notifCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), opacity 0.25s ease';
                    notifCard.style.transform = 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)';
                    notifCard.style.opacity = '1';
                    autoCloseTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                        closeNotifModal();
                    }, 4000);
                }
            }

            notifCard.addEventListener('touchstart', onTouchStart, { passive: true });
            window.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove, { passive: false });
            window.addEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd, { passive: true });

        'low soc': true, 'charge limit': true, 'starting charge': true, 'stopping charge': true,

    function isChargerStatusLabel(name) {
        if (!name || typeof name !== 'string') return true;
        var trimmed = name.trim();
        if (!trimmed) return true;
        if (CHARGER_STATUS_LABELS[trimmed.toLowerCase()]) return true;
        if (/^status\s+\d+$/i.test(trimmed)) return true;
        return false;
    }

        function getVehicleNameForSession(x) {
        if (!x) return '—';

        var normZone = normalizeZoneId(x.zoneId);
        var spotNum = x.spot != null ? Number(x.spot) : null;
        var cars = window.carsConfig || {};

        // 1. HIGHEST PRIORITY: Latest configured vehicle name for this spot in carsConfig
        if (normZone && spotNum != null) {
            var keys = [
                (x.zoneId || '') + '-' + x.spot,
                normZone + '-' + spotNum,
                normZone + '-' + x.spot,
                (x.zoneId || '') + '-' + spotNum
            ];
            for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
                var k = keys[i];
                if (cars[k] && cars[k].name && !isChargerStatusLabel(cars[k].name)) {
                    var vName = String(cars[k].name).trim();
                    if (vName && vName !== '—') return vName;
                }
            }

            // Also check live parkingData spot name
            if (Array.isArray(parkingData)) {
                var spot = parkingData.find(function (s) {
                    return normalizeZoneId(s.zoneId) === normZone && Number(s.spot) === spotNum;
                });
                if (spot && spot.name && !isChargerStatusLabel(spot.name)) {
                    var sName = String(spot.name).trim();
                    if (sName && sName !== '—') return sName;
                }
                if (spot && spot.activeUser && !isChargerStatusLabel(spot.activeUser)) {
                    var uName = String(spot.activeUser).trim();
                    if (uName && uName !== '—') return uName;
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Latest configured User Name from smartParkingConfig.USERS (by card ID or charger ID)
        if (window.currentSmartConfig && window.currentSmartConfig.USERS) {
            var cardId = x.card_id || x.cardId || x.activeCard;
            if (cardId && window.currentSmartConfig.USERS[cardId] && window.currentSmartConfig.USERS[cardId].name) {
                var cfgUserName = String(window.currentSmartConfig.USERS[cardId].name).trim();
                if (cfgUserName && !isChargerStatusLabel(cfgUserName)) return cfgUserName;
            }
            // Check if charger matches a user's assigned charger in config
            if (x.chargerId) {
                for (var uid in window.currentSmartConfig.USERS) {
                    var uObj = window.currentSmartConfig.USERS[uid];
                    if (uObj && uObj.charger && (uObj.charger === x.chargerId || uObj.charger.indexOf(x.chargerId) !== -1)) {
                        if (uObj.name && !isChargerStatusLabel(uObj.name)) {
                            // If this user was assigned to this specific zone/spot
                            if (uObj.zone && normalizeZoneId(uObj.zone) === normZone && Number(uObj.spot) === spotNum) {
                                return String(uObj.name).trim();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. User Name recorded on session if not generic/unknown
        if (x.user && String(x.user).trim() !== '' && !isChargerStatusLabel(x.user) && String(x.user).toLowerCase() !== 'unknown') {
            return String(x.user).trim();
        }

        // 4. Vehicle Name recorded on session
        if (x.name && !isChargerStatusLabel(x.name)) {
            var sessionName = String(x.name).trim();
            if (!x.chargerId || sessionName.toLowerCase() !== String(x.chargerId).toLowerCase()) {
                return sessionName;
            }
        }

        return (x.user && !isChargerStatusLabel(x.user) && x.user !== 'Unknown') ? x.user : '—';
    }
